items.title: Extortion Group Claims Manchester Airports Group Data Breach
items.summary: The FulcrumSec extortion group has claimed responsibility for the recently disclosed Manchester Airports Group (MAG) data breach. The largest airport group in the UK, MAG owns and operates Manchester, London Stansted, and East Midlands airports. MAG disclosed the incident on August 27, notifying customers that hackers stole data associated with car park, lounge, and Fast Track bookings, as well as in-airport Wi-Fi sign-ups at all three airports.

items.title: jvmi7/OfflinePainter — Offline Ed25519 signing toolkit - sign files, verify signatures, exchange keys via QR. Pure-Python RFC 8032, s
items.one_liner: An air-gapped, pure-Python Ed25519 signing and QR exchange toolkit provides dependency-free cryptographic operations for isolated machines.
items.summary: OfflinePainter is a pure-Python Ed25519 signing toolkit designed for air-gapped environments that handles file signing, signature verification, and QR-based key exchange without third-party dependencies. It uses standard library modules like hashlib, hmac, base64, os, and zlib, implementing an RFC 8032 Ed25519 core from scratch. Secret keys can be optionally encrypted using scrypt passphrases, and key material or signatures can be transferred across air gaps using SGDK1 QR payloads. Additionally, the package includes a minimal Android demo app to facilitate scanning QR keys and performing sign or verify operations.
key_facts: Dependencies: Zero third-party Python stdlib only
items.bottom_line: Developers needing air-gapped cryptographic signing can utilize a zero-dependency Python implementation that avoids clipboard exposure by transferring keys via QR codes.

items.title: UditAkhourii/cdaf — CDAF (Cached Descriptive Asset Files) - open sidecar format for video so AI agents stop re-analyzing the same
items.summary: Stop making AI agents watch the same video twice. CDAF is an open sidecar format for video: a plain-text, timestamped description that lives next to the video file with the same basename. Generate it once, and every AI agent that touches that footage afterward reads a few hundred text tokens instead of running a full video-understanding pass.

items.title: [webapps] C-MOR  6.0104 - Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.one_liner: C-MOR Video Surveillance XSS flaws allow client-side code execution via manipulated URL parameters.
items.summary: C-MOR Video Surveillance versions up to 6.0104 contain a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the 'size' parameter in the ptzpreset.pml component and the 'anyparam' parameter in the show-movies.pml component. An attacker can execute arbitrary client-side code by tricking an authenticated user into visiting a crafted URL. The issue is tracked as CVE-2026-51133.
items.bottom_line: C-MOR Video Surveillance versions up to 6.0104 are vulnerable to authenticated stored or reflected XSS via parameter inputs.

claims.text: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in za-internet GmbH C-MOR Video Surveillance <= V6.0104 allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary client-side code via the 'size' parameter in the ptzpreset.pml component and the 'anyparam' in the show-movies.pml component.

items.title: Selective Forgetting: A Graph-Based Memory Framework for Long-Term LLM Agents
items.one_liner: Graph-based memory frameworks for LLM agents do not outperform flat vector baselines, but automated pruning effectively reduces storage size.
items.summary: Researchers evaluated a graph-based memory framework for long-term LLM agents that extracts conversational turns into typed nodes and relations while periodically pruning low-scoring memories. On the LongMemEval benchmark, the graph structure did not outperform a flat vector retrieval baseline at matched candidate generation budgets, with token F1 dropping from 0.468 to 0.417. However, the forgetting module successfully pruned 9.8 percent of nodes and 9.5 percent of stored bytes from a large persistent graph without altering token F1 performance.
items.bottom_line: Flat vector retrieval outperforms knowledge graph structures for long-term LLM agent conversation recall.
